title: A benchmark proves routing by verdict pays
goal: benchmarks.py run route-by-verdict measures kb_ask.py against the bare Sonnet web arm on the none questions (s5_none, o1_offkb), the flagged ones (s8_falsegood2, h2_applock) and clean covered ones (s1_fact, s3_multi), and its report section shows: none within 10% of the bare arm's cost, flagged below both the kb Sonnet arm and the bare arm, covered on the reader route as before.
notes: Operator budget: paid runs up to $10 for this story. Fewer than 10% over bare on none is the bar the operator set; a miss is a finding for the review, not a reason to change the bar.
